rules.description: Ensures all active NotJuvenileJusticeFacility StatVars share the same latest observation date (MaxDate).

Verifies that every StatVar meets its expected latest observation date (2012 for pre-2014 non-JJ StatVars, >= 2024 for all NotJuvenileJusticeFacility StatVars and high-school JuvenileJusticeFacility grade-indicator StatVars, >= 2014/2016 for demographic JuvenileJusticeFacility StatVars, and >= 2024 for overall JuvenileJusticeFacility MaxDate).

params.query: SELECT StatVar, MinDate, MaxDate, CASE WHEN StatVar NOT LIKE '%JuvenileJusticeFacility%' THEN CAST(MaxDate AS INTEGER) >= 2012 WHEN StatVar LIKE '%NotJuvenileJusticeFacility%' THEN CAST(MaxDate AS INTEGER) >= 2024 WHEN StatVar IN ('Count_Student_JuvenileJusticeFacility_SchoolGrade9_StudentRetained', 'Count_Student_JuvenileJusticeFacility_SchoolGrade10_StudentRetained', 'Count_Student_JuvenileJusticeFacility_SchoolGrade11_StudentRetained', 'Count_Student_JuvenileJusticeFacility_SchoolGrade12_StudentRetained') THEN CAST(MaxDate AS INTEGER) >= 2024 WHEN CAST(MinDate AS INTEGER) = 2014 THEN CAST(MaxDate AS INTEGER) >= 2014 WHEN CAST(MinDate AS INTEGER) = 2016 THEN CAST(MaxDate AS INTEGER) >= 2016 WHEN CAST(MinDate AS INTEGER) >= 2018 THEN CAST(MaxDate AS INTEGER) >= 2024 ELSE FALSE END AS is_fresh FROM stats UNION ALL SELECT 'JJ_FRESHNESS_SUMMARY' AS StatVar, COALESCE(CAST(MIN(CAST(MinDate AS INTEGER)) AS VARCHAR), '') AS MinDate, COALESCE(CAST(MAX(CAST(MaxDate AS INTEGER)) AS VARCHAR), '') AS MaxDate, COALESCE(MAX(CAST(MaxDate AS INTEGER)), 0) >= 2024 AS is_fresh FROM stats WHERE StatVar LIKE '%JuvenileJusticeFacility%' AND StatVar NOT LIKE '%NotJuvenileJusticeFacility%'
